objective: 95% melanoma sensitivity with fewer false positives on clinical dermoscopy
evaluation_unit: recorded lesion ID; DERM image IDs are lesion proxies
limitations: Reused development data: checkpoint/architecture selection already used this cohort. Scoring groups are excluded from each fold's blend and threshold fitting, but this does not make the checkpoint independently selected or establish generalization. Fixed candidates are reported separately; selecting a winner from these results introduces further development selection. Blend and threshold share the calibration partition. Scores are not clinically calibrated probabilities. No test or HIBA data are accessed.
The corrected-clean-head historical baseline used arithmetic-mean image probabilities; use the canonical comparison for checkpoint results.
No newer checkpoint or clinical deployment is published by this source update.
